 Audiences were eager to get back to Camp Crystal Lake . 
 Peacock ‘s Crystal Lake , which debuted on October 15, has generated 1.3 billion minutes watched in its first 11 days, per the latest Nielsen data. NBCUniversal says that makes it the fourth-best scripted original series ever on the streaming platform.
 As of the most recent Nielsen data available (which is generally about two weeks delayed), during the week of October 19, Crystal Lake ranked as the No. 3 streaming original series and first-season series.

 Fans are also buzzing about Crystal Lake online. NBCU’s data shows that the series has tallied 1.8 billion earned impressions in the first 24 hours and more than 7.6 million video views in its first 11 days.
 Watch on Deadline 
 From A24 and creator Brad Caleb Kane, Crystal Lake is an expansion of the Friday the 13 th universe stars Linda Cardellini as Pam Voorhees, a single mother who has been unable to shake her grief after her young, sickly son Jason tragically drowned in the town lake almost a year before.
 All eight episodes of the horror series hit Peacock on October 15. 
 Alongside Cardellini, series regulars include William Catlett, Devin Kessler, Cameron Scoggins and Gwendolyn Sundstrom. Recurring cast includes Callum Vinson, Nick Cordileone, Joy Suprano, Danielle Kotch, Phoenix Parnevik.
 Executive producers include Brad Caleb Kane, Marc Toberoff, Victor Miller, Robert M. Barsamian, Robert P. Barsamian, Stuart Manashil, Tyson Bidner, Michael Lennox and Roy Lee. Michael Lennox directed the first three episodes. Celine Held and Logan George directed episodes 104-106. Quyen Tran directed the penultimate and finale episodes.
